parole.testo: From Ottoman Turkish سلام (selam), from Old Anatolian Turkish سلام, from Arabic سَلَام (salām) (the sense 'greeting' of the Arabic word is likely a semantic loan from Aramaic שְׁלָמָא / ܫܠܵܡܵܐ (šəlāmā), compare its Hebrew cognate שלום (shalóm, “hello”)), likely via Classical Persian سلام (salām). parole.significato: sesame, a tropical, Asian plant of the species Sesamum indicum
parole.testo: Inherited from Ottoman Turkish صوسام (susam), from older سیسم (sisam), from either Arabic سِمْسِم (simsim) or Ancient Greek σήσαμον (sḗsamon), both from Aramaic שומשומא (šumššemā, “sesame”).
